notes: Starter rule set. Mod ids are matched case-insensitively against the ids inside each jar. Add your own rules in a file and pass it with --rules (CLI) or the Rules file box (GUI); lists are appended to these.

conflicts.message: OptiFine/OptiFabric does not work together with Sodium, Embeddium, Rubidium, Iris or Oculus. Those mods replace OptiFine's performance and shader features, so keep only one family.

redundant.message: Sodium, Embeddium and Rubidium are the same rendering engine (ports/forks of one another). Only one should be installed. Rubidium is discontinued in favour of Embeddium.
Phosphor and Starlight both replace the game's lighting engine and are not meant to run together.
JEI, REI and EMI all provide recipe/item browsing. Running more than one is rarely useful and can clash on keybinds and screen overlays. Pick one (JEI has the widest mod support).
Several minimap mods are installed. They draw on the same part of the screen and each keeps its own waypoints; pick one.

recommended.title: No rendering optimizer installed
recommended.message: A rendering optimizer is usually the biggest FPS improvement for client play.

recommended.title: Lithium (game logic optimizations) is not installed
recommended.message: Lithium speeds up game logic (entity AI, chunk handling, ticking) without changing gameplay.

recommended.title: FerriteCore (memory optimizations) is not installed
recommended.message: FerriteCore reduces memory usage, which matters most in large packs.

recommended.title: ModernFix (startup and memory fixes) is not installed
recommended.message: ModernFix improves load times and memory use and fixes several common vanilla/mod performance bugs.

config_rules.message: view-distance is {current}. In large modpacks a high view distance is one of the biggest server CPU and memory costs; 8-10 is a common starting point.
simulation-distance is {current}. Entities and machines within this radius are ticked every game tick, which gets expensive with many mods; 5-8 is a common range for large packs.
